title: EpiScope NL-to-FOL Paper with Epidemic Scope Model

Bibliography has 13 verified BibTeX entries (LINC, FOLIO, Logic-LM, AMS, Kamath2024, SIR, Newman2005, spaCy, etc.). Compiled with pdflatex/bibtex/pdflatex/pdflatex sequence successfully. PDF verified at 12 pages. Visual review of all pages confirmed clean layout, no overlapping figures, no cut-off text, and correct citations throughout.
